//: Generated reference payloads for OphirPay webhook events. Validated by tests/automation-payloads.test.ts against the WEBHOOK_EVENTS registry and the payload envelope shape used by src/lib/webhook-dispatcher.ts. Do not hand-edit: run `npm run test -- tests/automation-payloads.test.ts` afterwards.

created.description: A payment row exists but has not been submitted to the network yet. Your automation should record the payment as pending and never act on it financially.

signed.description: The transaction envelope is signed locally. Nothing is on-chain yet — a signed payment can still be discarded before submission.

submitted.description: The signed envelope was accepted by Horizon for inclusion in a ledger. Inclusion is not finality — the result is still unknown.

confirmed.description: The ledger containing the transaction has been confirmed by the network. The payment succeeded; funds movement is settled from this point.

failed.description: The network rejected the transaction or the submission timed out. The payment row stays pending so it can be retried — treat this as a recoverable signal, not a loss.

data.errorMessage: The transaction failed when submitted to the stellar network.
